question: Should OpenClaw fail closed before `sessions_send` delivery when propagated inter-agent provenance shows the target agent already participated in the current route?
rationale: The patch is a bounded source-level fix, but it intentionally changes existing cyclic or revisit routes from delivered agent work into tool errors, which is a product and compatibility decision rather than a pure correctness judgment.

options.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking
options.body: Land this direction after real A -> B -> C -> A proof and the small duplicate-chain cleanup so cyclic routes stop before the repeated agent run.

options.title: Preserve cyclic revisits
options.body: Pause or close this PR if legitimate workflows must be able to revisit an agent in the same route without a tool error.

options.title: Require explicit route policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose an opt-in, thresholded, or documented route policy for agent revisits.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking
recommendation.body: Land this direction after real A -> B -> C -> A proof and the small duplicate-chain cleanup so cyclic routes stop before the repeated agent run.
